title: Senior Data Scientist

company_info.type: Iranian company dealing only with Iranian entities

job_description:
At Azki’s Data Team, we are looking for a Senior Data Scientist — a responsible and skilled problem-solver who can turn complex data into AI-powered solutions and data-driven products.
Responsibilities
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams (data, product, engineering, and business stakeholders) to design and deliver data science and AI projects.
Build reliable end-to-end data science and machine learning pipelines with automated deployment, real-time monitoring, and robust evaluation metrics.
Design and run experiments (A/B tests) to measure the impact of models, product changes, and business initiatives.
Design and optimize RAG pipelines, embeddings, and vector search systems to enable efficient knowledge retrieval across structured and unstructured data.
Design, build, and maintain LLM-powered agents and workflows with tool integration, memory, and API calls to solve real problems in Azki’s product domain.
Required Skills
At least 4 years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or related fields.
Proficiency in Python, with the ability to write clean, modular, maintainable, production-ready code.
Solid knowledge of Machine Learning and Deep Learning methods.
Hands-on experience with LLM applications and agent orchestration tools such as LangGraph.
Experience deploying models at production scale using Git, Docker, Airflow, Kubernetes.
Strong SQL skills and familiarity with databases such as MySQL and ClickHouse, along with analytics tools like Metabase and Trino.
Preferred/Optional Skills
Experience with real-time voice processing, including speech recognition, transcription, or audio feature extraction for ML applications.
Familiarity with Vision-Language Models, including multimodal tasks such as image captioning, visual question answering, or integrating visual understanding into LLM applications.
Experience in mentoring and supporting team members in their career growth, including close collaboration and pair work to improve project outcomes.
